data.name: PinUnlockText
data.value: Enter your PIN to unlock the BorgStudio vault.

data.name: PinCreateText
data.value: With a PIN, BorgStudio is locked at start and after a while without use, and passphrases are kept encrypted with a key derived from the PIN. Without the PIN nobody can read them – not even BorgStudio. A forgotten PIN cannot be recovered: then only resetting the vault (the passphrases in it are lost) or importing an export helps.

data.name: PinHint
data.value: At least {0} characters; letters and digits are allowed. Longer is safer.

data.name: PinTooShort
data.value: The PIN needs at least {0} characters.

data.name: PinMismatch
data.value: The two PINs do not match.

data.name: SettingsVaultIntro
data.value: With a PIN, BorgStudio starts locked and locks itself again after the time set below. Unlocking also opens the vault, which keeps the repository passphrases encrypted – so they are not asked for again. Lock at any time with Ctrl+L.

data.name: SettingsAutoLockHint
data.value: …without using BorgStudio. Then the app has to be unlocked with the PIN again.

data.name: VaultSetUpDone
data.value: The vault is set up and unlocked.

data.name: VaultResetWarning
data.value: This deletes the vault with all passphrases stored in it and removes the PIN. It cannot be undone. Repositories that kept their passphrase in the vault will ask for it again. Only do this if you forgot your PIN.

data.name: VaultResetDone
data.value: The vault was deleted. You can set up a new PIN.

data.name: LockScreenText
data.value: Enter your PIN to unlock BorgStudio. This also opens the vault with your passphrases.

data.name: ExportIntro
data.value: Saves everything in one file to set BorgStudio up again on another computer: repositories, stored passphrases, SSH keys, known servers and settings. The file is encrypted with a password of its own – without it nobody can read the file, and you cannot either.
